what_supernova_evaluates: Pauses, continuity, ability to keep speaking
beginner_target_by_week_50: Can speak in connected short stretches on familiar topics; pauses do not stop communication.

what_supernova_evaluates: Accuracy and control of taught structures
beginner_target_by_week_50: Can use core everyday structures accurately enough to communicate; errors remain but rarely block meaning.

what_supernova_evaluates: Range and retrieval of everyday words/phrases
beginner_target_by_week_50: Can retrieve practical everyday vocabulary and paraphrase when a word is missing.
Generally understandable to a patient listener; can improve recurring pronunciation issues.

what_supernova_evaluates: How easily a listener understands the message
beginner_target_by_week_50: Message is understandable in familiar everyday contexts.
Can answer basic follow-ups, ask questions, clarify and keep a simple conversation going.

what_supernova_evaluates: Ability to respond without a script
beginner_target_by_week_50: Can respond to familiar and some unexpected questions without relying entirely on memorized sentences.
